description: Source code for Bluetooth ISO broadcast broadcaster using Zephyr RTOS, managing ISO channels, BIG creation, and periodic data broadcasting.

methods.name: iso_connected
methods.description: Handles ISO channel connection event, increments connected BIS count, signals when all are connected.

methods.name: iso_disconnected
methods.description: Handles ISO channel disconnection event, decrements connected BIS count, signals when all are disconnected.

methods.name: get_chars
methods.description: Reads characters from console input into buffer, converts to lowercase, terminates on newline or carriage return.

methods.name: parse_rtn_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set RTN value, validates input.

methods.name: parse_interval_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set ISO interval in microseconds, validates input.

methods.name: parse_latency_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set latency in milliseconds, validates input.

methods.name: parse_phy_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set PHY (1M, 2M, Coded), validates input.

methods.name: parse_sdu_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set SDU size, validates input.

methods.name: parse_irc_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set IRC, validates input (test params).

methods.name: parse_pto_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set PTO, validates input (test params).

methods.name: parse_iso_interval_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set ISO interval, validates input (test params).

methods.name: parse_nse_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set number of subevents, validates input (test params).

methods.name: parse_max_pdu_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set max PDU size, validates input (test params).

methods.name: parse_bn_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set burst number, validates input (test params).

methods.name: parse_packing_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set packing mode, validates input.

methods.name: parse_framing_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set framing mode, validates input.

methods.name: parse_bis_count_arg
methods.description: Prompts user to set BIS count, validates input.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Runs all parameter parsing prompts, updates configuration accordingly.

methods.name: iso_timer_timeout
methods.description: Periodic callback to send ISO data packets, reschedules itself based on interval.

methods.name: create_big
methods.description: Creates advertising set, configures periodic advertising, starts advertising, creates BIG, waits for completion.

methods.name: delete_big
methods.description: Terminates BIG, stops advertising, deletes advertising set.

methods.name: reset_sems
methods.description: Resets synchronization semaphores.

methods.name: test_run_broadcaster
methods.description: Main function to run the ISO broadcast broadcaster, manages user interaction, BIG creation, data transmission, and cleanup.
